cpu.desc: CPU allocation in threads. 100% = 1 thread, 200% = 2 threads. Arma Reforger wants at least 4

disk.desc: Disk space allocation in MB (30720 MB = 30 GB)

memory.desc: How much memory in MB to allocate

ip.desc: What IP to bind the server to

publicaddress.desc: Public IP address the server registers in the server browser. Leave empty to let the game detect it; set it when players cannot connect, for example behind Docker or NAT

servername.desc: Name shown in the server browser

serverpassword.desc: Password players need to join. Empty means anyone can join

adminpassword.desc: Password for in-game admin login (#login in chat). Change it

rconpassword.desc: Password for RCON tools. At least 3 characters and no spaces, or the server refuses to start

scenarioid.desc: Scenario to run. The default is Conflict on Everon; start once with the scenario list in the log to see the others

visible.desc: Show the server in the server browser

maxfps.desc: Server frame cap. Bohemia recommends 60 to 120; without it the server uses all the CPU it can

commands: bash -c "for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do steamcmd +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux +force_install_dir /SkyPanel +login anonymous +app_update 1874900 validate +quit && exit 0; echo 'steamcmd could not finish the download, trying again in 15s ($try/5)'; sleep 15; done; exit 1"

install.text:
{
  "bindAddress": "0.0.0.0",
  "bindPort": ${port},
  "publicAddress": "${publicaddress}",
  "publicPort": ${port},
  "a2s": {
    "port": ${queryport},
    "address": "0.0.0.0"
  },
  "rcon": {
    "port": ${rconport},
    "password": "${rconpassword}",
    "address": "0.0.0.0",
    "permission": "monitor",
    "blacklist": [],
    "whitelist": []
  },
  "game": {
    "name": "${servername}",
    "password": "${serverpassword}",
    "passwordAdmin": "${adminpassword}",
    "admins": [],
    "scenarioId": "${scenarioid}",
    "maxPlayers": ${maxplayers},
    "visible": ${visible},
    "gameProperties": {
      "serverMaxViewDistance": 2500,
      "serverMinGrassDistance": 100,
      "networkViewDistance": 1500,
      "disableThirdPerson": false,
      "fastValidation": true,
      "battlEye": true,
      "VONDisableUI": false,
      "VONDisableDirectSpeechUI": false,
      "VONCanTransmitCrossFaction": false
    },
    "mods": []
  },
  "operating": {
    "lobbyPlayerSynchronise": true
  }
}
